title: AI Fragmentation Coding Record
description: One coding record per legal provision, produced by an LLM in Step 2 and finalized through Steps 3-6. Every record must cite the exact provision text (quote) that grounds the codes.

chunk_id.description: Stable identifier of the provision chunk, e.g. EU_AI_ACT#012

article_ref.description: Human-readable location of the provision inside the instrument

applies.description: True if the provision falls within at least one coding domain; otherwise false and all coding fields are null

domains.description: Domains the provision touches (may be more than one)

direction.description: Whether the provision restricts or enables the coded activity

scope.description: Which actors and AI uses the provision covers (one sentence)

quote.description: Exact verbatim text span from the provision that justifies the codes
